shared_elements: repeated short strokes or hatch marks
highly stylized anthropomorphic or figure-like forms
justification: The limited overlap is that both use highly schematic, linear conventions with simple circles/discs and repeated short strokes, and both may include stylized figure-like forms. The major difference is that A is dominated by many long boat-like forms with rows of marks/crew and small surrounding signs, while B presents a single large frontal anthropomorphic figure with body discs and curved bands, so the iconographic scheme and arrangement do not correspond.
